parsed.restated: ∀ {n : ℕ}, 32 ≤ n → ∀ (f : Formula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), Formula.eval f = permanentPolynomial n → (n : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ 128 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) * (Formula.variableLeaves f : ℝ)
parsed.proof:
constructor
· intro h n hn f hf
  have hpos : 0 < Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) := Real.logb_pos (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < n))
  have h1 := h hn f hf
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hpos)] at h1
  linarith
· intro h n hn f hf
  have hpos : 0 < Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) := Real.logb_pos (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < n))
  have h1 := h hn f hf
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hpos)]
  linarith
parsed.english: For every n ≥ 32 and every division-free arithmetic formula over ℂ in the variables x_{ij} that evaluates to the permanent polynomial of the n×n generic matrix, we have n^4 ≤ 128 · log₂(n) · (number of variable leaves of the formula).
parsed.why_clearer: It removes the division by 128·log₂ n, which is legitimate since log₂ n > 0 for n ≥ 32, and gives the bound in multiplicative form.
